title: GS21 with the investment cost dependent on LEVERAGE and the priced state: cost x exp(-1.0 b~ y), one type, GS21's own debt dynamics
question: Does a y exposure that is the product of the firm's leverage and its investment option make room in GS21, where the level investment-cost exposure (gvyi25) left 1%?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-28, user request). gvyi25 put y on every firm's investment cost (room 1%: the option is a small share of GS21 equity and the exposure is a level). Here the cost multiplier is exp(gs_bib b~ y) with gs_bib = -1.0 (gvyi25's largest magnitude): a levered firm finds investment dear when y is low, an unlevered firm cheap, so the exposure through the option is leverage times the option's value, with a cross-sectional mean near zero. New solver / simulator knob gs_bib (2026-10-28), inert at 0: the (NY,) cost multiplier cy becomes (NY, bnum) over the CURRENT coupon, broadcast in the investment cutoffs; the simulator pays icost x exp((gs_bi + gs_bib b~(b_t)) y). One type, no level compensation (nothing to hide at y = 0).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-28): room 1 to 5% of the linear ceiling, no gap: the option is too small a share of GS21 equity for its exposure to matter, and leverage is now an observed characteristic.

changes: three level investment-cost types gs_bi -0.2/-0.6/-1.0 -> one type with gs_bi 0 and gs_bib -1.0 (cost x exp(gs_bib b~ y))
one solve sol_gvyiba; everything else gvyi25's (gamma_v 2.5, kappa_y 0.35, NY 9, y_mult 2.5, bv_comp 0)

method.gs_vy_exposure: investment cost x exp(gs_bib b~ y), b~ = (b - 0.5)/0.29 the standardized current coupon; production does not load on y

seeds.policy: run_oracle.py --seed drives BOTH the firm-level shocks and the aggregate y path (reg_seed offset by the seed).
